entities.summary: Taranto Cathedral is a Roman Catholic cathedral in Taranto, Apulia, Italy, dedicated to Saint Catald, who is the city's patron saint. It is the archiepiscopal seat of the Archdiocese of Taranto. The Cathedral was built by the Byzantines in the 10th Century AD, under Emperor Nicephorus II Phoca, over an earlier construction dating from the 5th century, and it is the oldest cathedral in Puglia.
